title: Blacksmith one craft from seeded reagents

workstation.if_required: stage by native route to a legitimate forge; do not count a seeded position as travel proof

preparation.purpose: Seed the exact profession and reagent state, then capture a stable inventory baseline.
steps: Allocate one dedicated wayfarer/out-of-roster character with no campaign ownership.
Seed Blacksmithing, the recipe spell, exactly the declared reagents, enough free bag space, and no pre-existing output item if possible.
Verify professioneconomy reports the recipe and that immediately_craftable is true before the operation.
Capture read-only inventory, skills, professioneconomy, snapshot, and craft-status baselines.
If a forge is required by the native recipe, route to it using a legitimate native route before the operation window.

operation.purpose: Issue exactly one native craft and wait for the server's completion receipt.
native_evidence_required: craft response accepts the exact spell id
craft-status reports completed=true and a native proof field
read-only inventory shows the exact output delta
read-only inventory shows reagent consumption consistent with the recipe

postconditions.predicate: completed is true, pending is false, and proof is a server-native completion receipt

postconditions.observable: read-only character inventory after a stable save boundary
postconditions.predicate: output_item_id increases by output_quantity and the delta follows the accepted spell
reagent count decreases by the recipe requirement, allowing native failure rules

adapter_still_needed: seed exact profession, recipe, reagents, and free bag state
durable inventory delta when craft-status does not include it

cleanup: do not refund or fabricate output in the proof path
record the final inventory for fixture reset
